Name: Doorway chest stretch
Instructions:
Setup: Stand in a doorway with the forearms on the frame, elbows near shoulder height.
1. Step one foot through until the chest feels a mild stretch.
2. Keep the ribs down.
3. Hold without bouncing.
4. Ease off at once if you feel pain, numbness, or tingling.
Breathing: Breathe slowly. Do not hold the breath.
Common mistakes: Shrugging the shoulders, or stepping through until the stretch is sharp.

Name: Seated chest opener
Instructions:
Setup: Sit tall and rest the hands on the chair behind the hips.
1. Open the chest a small amount.
2. Keep the shoulders away from the ears.
3. Hold the easy range.
4. Ease off at once if you feel pain, numbness, or tingling.
Breathing: Breathe slowly. Do not hold the breath.
Common mistakes: Leaning far back, or forcing the hands together behind the back.

Name: Kneeling lat stretch
Instructions:
Setup: Kneel in front of a chair and rest both hands on the seat.
1. Sit the hips back until the side of the back feels a mild stretch.
2. Keep the shoulders relaxed.
3. Hold without pulling harder.
4. Ease off at once if you feel pain, numbness, or tingling.
Breathing: Breathe slowly into the side that feels the stretch.
Common mistakes: Rounding the low back hard, or shrugging the shoulders.

Name: Seated lat reach
Instructions:
Setup: Sit tall and hold one wrist with the other hand.
1. Reach the arms a short way overhead and lean slightly to one side.
2. Keep the stretch mild.
3. Switch sides halfway through the hold.
4. Ease off at once if you feel pain, numbness, or tingling.
Breathing: Breathe slowly. Do not hold the breath.
Common mistakes: Pulling the wrist hard, or leaning until the side pinches.

Name: Cross-body shoulder stretch
Instructions:
Setup: Stand or sit tall and bring one arm across the chest.
1. Support the arm above the elbow with the other hand.
2. Keep the shoulder down.
3. Switch sides halfway through the hold.
4. Ease off at once if you feel pain, numbness, or tingling.
Breathing: Breathe slowly. Do not hold the breath.
Common mistakes: Pulling on the elbow joint, or lifting the shoulder toward the ear.

Name: Supported shoulder stretch
Instructions:
Setup: Rest the forearm on a table or the back of a chair, across the body.
1. Let the table support the arm.
2. Keep the stretch mild.
3. Switch sides halfway through the hold.
4. Ease off at once if you feel pain, numbness, or tingling.
Breathing: Breathe slowly. Do not hold the breath.
Common mistakes: Pressing the arm down into the table, or twisting the trunk.

Name: Wall arm extension
Instructions:
Setup: Stand with the palm on a wall beside you, arm straight, thumb pointing down.
1. Turn the body slightly away until the front of the arm feels a mild stretch.
2. Keep the elbow soft.
3. Switch sides halfway through the hold.
4. Ease off at once if you feel pain, numbness, or tingling.
Breathing: Breathe slowly. Do not hold the breath.
Common mistakes: Locking the elbow hard, or turning until the stretch is sharp.

Name: Seated arm extension
Instructions:
Setup: Sit and place one palm on the seat behind the hip, fingers pointing away.
1. Slide the hand back only a little until the front of the arm feels a mild stretch.
2. Keep the elbow soft.
3. Switch sides halfway through the hold.
4. Ease off at once if you feel pain, numbness, or tingling.
Breathing: Breathe slowly. Do not hold the breath.
Common mistakes: Locking the elbow, or leaning the full body weight onto the hand.

Name: Overhead triceps stretch
Instructions:
Setup: Sit or stand tall and bend one elbow so the hand rests behind the head.
1. Use the other hand to support the elbow.
2. Keep the stretch mild.
3. Switch sides halfway through the hold.
4. Ease off at once if you feel pain, numbness, or tingling.
Breathing: Breathe slowly. Do not hold the breath.
Common mistakes: Pulling the elbow behind the head, or arching the low back.

Name: Cross-body triceps stretch
Instructions:
Setup: Bring one hand to the opposite shoulder.
1. Use the other hand to support the arm above the elbow.
2. Keep the stretch mild.
3. Switch sides halfway through the hold.
4. Ease off at once if you feel pain, numbness, or tingling.
Breathing: Breathe slowly. Do not hold the breath.
Common mistakes: Pulling the elbow across hard, or shrugging.

Name: Wrist extensor stretch
Instructions:
Setup: Hold one arm in front of you with the elbow soft and the palm facing down.
1. Use the other hand to bend the wrist gently downward.
2. Keep the stretch mild.
3. Switch sides halfway through the hold.
4. Ease off at once if you feel pain, numbness, or tingling.
Breathing: Breathe slowly. Do not hold the breath.
Common mistakes: Pulling the fingers hard, or locking the elbow.

Name: Supported wrist stretch
Instructions:
Setup: Sit and rest the forearm on the thigh, palm down.
1. Let the hand relax over the knee.
2. Keep the stretch mild.
3. Switch sides halfway through the hold.
4. Ease off at once if you feel pain, numbness, or tingling.
Breathing: Breathe slowly. Do not hold the breath.
Common mistakes: Pressing the hand down with the other hand, or locking the elbow.

Name: Standing quad stretch
Instructions:
Setup: Stand beside a wall and hold it for balance.
1. Bend one knee and hold the ankle behind you.
2. Keep the knees close and the stretch mild.
3. Switch sides halfway through the hold.
4. Ease off at once if you feel pain, numbness, or tingling.
Breathing: Breathe slowly. Do not hold the breath.
Common mistakes: Pulling the heel into the hip hard, or leaning the trunk sideways.

Name: Side-lying quad stretch
Instructions:
Setup: Lie on one side with the head supported.
1. Bend the top knee and hold the ankle behind you.
2. Keep the stretch mild.
3. Switch sides halfway through the hold.
4. Ease off at once if you feel pain, numbness, or tingling.
Breathing: Breathe slowly. Do not hold the breath.
Common mistakes: Pulling the heel hard, or letting the low back arch.

Name: Supine hamstring stretch
Instructions:
Setup: Lie on your back with one knee bent and the foot on the floor.
1. Raise the other leg and hold the thigh.
2. Keep a soft knee and a mild stretch.
3. Switch sides halfway through the hold.
4. Ease off at once if you feel pain, numbness, or tingling.
Breathing: Breathe slowly. Do not hold the breath.
Common mistakes: Pulling the leg straight until the stretch is sharp, or lifting the hips.

Name: Seated hamstring stretch
Instructions:
Setup: Sit on a chair with one heel on the floor and that knee softly bent.
1. Hinge forward a short way from the hips.
2. Keep the back long and the stretch mild.
3. Switch sides halfway through the hold.
4. Ease off at once if you feel pain, numbness, or tingling.
Breathing: Breathe slowly. Do not hold the breath.
Common mistakes: Rounding the back to reach the toes, or locking the knee hard.

Name: Figure-four stretch
Instructions:
Setup: Lie on your back with both knees bent.
1. Cross one ankle over the opposite thigh.
2. Hold the thigh and keep the stretch mild.
3. Switch sides halfway through the hold.
4. Ease off at once if you feel pain, numbness, or tingling.
Breathing: Breathe slowly. Do not hold the breath.
Common mistakes: Pulling the thigh hard, or twisting the low back off the floor.

Name: Knee hug
Instructions:
Setup: Lie on your back with both knees bent.
1. Hug one knee toward the chest only a short way.
2. Keep the other foot on the floor.
3. Switch sides halfway through the hold.
4. Ease off at once if you feel pain, numbness, or tingling.
Breathing: Breathe slowly. Do not hold the breath.
Common mistakes: Pulling the knee hard into the chest, or holding the breath.

Name: Wall calf stretch
Instructions:
Setup: Stand facing a wall with one foot back and both feet pointing forward.
1. Bend the front knee until the back calf feels a mild stretch.
2. Keep the back heel down and the back knee soft.
3. Switch sides halfway through the hold.
4. Ease off at once if you feel pain, numbness, or tingling.
Breathing: Breathe slowly. Do not hold the breath.
Common mistakes: Forcing the heel down until the stretch is sharp, or turning the back foot out.

Name: Seated calf stretch
Instructions:
Setup: Sit with one leg out and a towel around the forefoot.
1. Draw the toes toward you only a little.
2. Keep the knee soft.
3. Switch sides halfway through the hold.
4. Ease off at once if you feel pain, numbness, or tingling.
Breathing: Breathe slowly. Do not hold the breath.
Common mistakes: Yanking the towel, or locking the knee.

Name: Gentle abdominal opener
Instructions:
Setup: Lie on your front with the hands under the shoulders.
1. Press the floor just enough to lift the chest a small amount.
2. Keep the hips down.
3. Hold the easy range.
4. Ease off at once if you feel pain, numbness, or tingling.
Breathing: Breathe slowly. Do not hold the breath.
Common mistakes: Pushing up until the low back pinches, or holding the breath.

Name: Hands-and-knees belly ease
Instructions:
Setup: Start on the hands and knees.
1. Let the belly relax toward the floor only a little.
2. Keep the movement small.
3. Return to a neutral spine if the back feels tight.
4. Ease off at once if you feel pain, numbness, or tingling.
Breathing: Breathe slowly. Do not hold the breath.
Common mistakes: Dropping the belly hard, or holding the breath.
